lines.en: Why did Harrison sell his house so quickly?
lines.cn: 为什么哈里森这么快就卖掉了他的房子？

lines.en: My old friend, Harrison, had lived in
lines.cn: 我的老朋友哈里森曾经住在这里。

lines.en: the Mediterranean for many years
lines.cn: 多年来，地中海地区一直是人们关注的焦点（或：多年来，地中海地区一直备受人们的关注）。

lines.en: before he returned to England.
lines.cn: 在他回到英格兰之前。

lines.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England
lines.cn: 他经常梦想着在英格兰退休。

lines.en: and had planned to settle down in the country.
lines.cn: 并且原本计划在这个乡村安顿下来生活。

lines.en: He had no sooner returned than he bought
lines.cn: 他一回来，就立刻买了东西。

lines.en: a house and went to live there.
lines.cn: 他们买了一栋房子，然后搬去那里住了。

lines.en: Almost immediately he began to complain
lines.cn: 几乎立刻，他就开始抱怨起来。

lines.en: about the weather,
lines.cn: 关于天气的情况。

lines.en: for even though it was still summer,
lines.cn: 因为尽管那时仍是夏天……

lines.en: it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.
lines.cn: 雨一直下个不停，天气也常常非常寒冷。

lines.en: After so many years of sunshine,
lines.cn: 经历了这么多年的阳光照耀之后……

lines.en: Harrison got a shock.
lines.cn: 哈里森感到非常震惊。

lines.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
lines.cn: 他的举止就好像他以前从未在英国生活过一样。

lines.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
lines.cn: 最终，这超出了他的承受能力。

lines.en: He had hardly had time to settle down
lines.cn: 他几乎还没来得及安顿下来呢。

lines.en: when he sold the house and left the country.
lines.cn: 当他卖掉房子并离开这个国家的时候。

lines.en: The dream he had had for so many years ended there.
lines.cn: 他多年来一直怀有的梦想，就在那一刻结束了。

lines.en: Harrison had thought of everything except the weather.
lines.cn: 哈里森考虑到了所有可能的因素，唯独没有考虑到天气。
